evidence: Modifies src/index/coinstatsindex.cpp to delete the legacy indexes/coinstats directory on startup.
rationale: Automates cleanup of obsolete index data to reclaim disk space on upgraded nodes. As noted in the description, 'nodes upgraded from v29 or earlier retain the legacy indexes/coinstats directory indefinitely unless manually deleted, wasting disk space,' and this completes a scheduled cleanup after v29 reached end-of-life.
